design_timing: Prospective extension designed after examining original20 results. New texts, rubrics and temporal windows frozen before running the new20. No preregistration or statistically independent held-out study is claimed.

original_queries.preservation: Original bytes are the exact prefix of queries.all40.jsonl; original runs and all 737 assessments remain untouched.

assessment.source: Read full available title and body; store article hash, rationale and verbatim evidence with offsets. Disclose assessor origin. No transfer of original-qrel labels to different information needs.
assessment.negation: Explicit supporting assertion required; silence is not evidence of negation.
assessment.temporal: Start=anchor+1 day; end=anchor+specified days, inclusive. Event-time evidence required in article. No publication-date or UUID inference.
assessment.pooling: Union both engines' top20; deduplicate by query/document ID. Rank/engine metadata stored separately from articles. No perfect blindness claimed.
assessment.retain_all_queries: Keep every frozen query including zero-positive pools; never replace a query based on its winner or its score.

analysis_plan.primary: nDCG@5 with linear gains and pooled MAP@1000 after complete designated-pool assessment; binary relevance grade>0 for AP.
analysis_plan.reporting: Report original20, extension20 and combined40 separately. Do not replace completed20 metrics with unassessed40 claims. Report P@5, per-query differences, category means, wins/ties/losses and judged coverage.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Paired differences at query level; additionally bootstrap shared topic families together. Ten queries/category remain exploratory, purposively selected and not representative of all news searches.
analysis_plan.dependency_caveat: Shared families include cricket, Java and Mercury. Family labels are a conservative design aid, not proof that all remaining topics are independent.
analysis_plan.no_tuning: Keep engines/model/input limits unchanged. Any passage indexing, filtering or reranking remains a separately named experiment.
